details.completeness_justification: K1, K5, K6 and K7 are fully covered. K2 is only partial because the candidate omits the adjusted EBITDA margin of ~41% and the exact SEK 2.96 million positive EBITDA figure. K3 is partial because it mentions only two of the four named agreements and omits the SEK 21 million contract value and the two German distribution partners. K4, K8 and K9 are entirely absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: sales growth (S2–S4) is explained by commercial contracts (S3), the operating loss narrows (S5) and EBITDA turns positive (S6), with a clear adjustment for one-off costs (S7). The deterioration in financial items (S8) is presented as the direct cause of the deeper net loss (S9). Balance-sheet contraction (S11–S12) is explicitly linked to impairments and divestments, and cash-flow movements (S13–S15) are consistent with the described financing and investing activities. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or unnecessary repetitions are present; the narrative flows from operations to financial results to balance-sheet and cash effects, forming a single, well-organized whole.
